scope.accuracy_ratio: control RMS / two_basis RMS; exp(mean paired log ratio) from original claims
scope.interval: original descriptive crossed-cluster bootstrap log limits, exponentiated; 1000 replicates; no multiplicity correction
scope.coverage: all paired evaluated grids and training seeds must meet both RMS/max target for each field
scope.missing_schedule: zero coverage can mean no feasible validation-selected schedule, not universal method failure
